items.title: Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day
items.summary: Armory Castle exploited CVE-2026-102764 for initial access, deployed custom tools, and deleted logs and artifacts. The post Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 中國 APT 將 BeyondTrust 漏洞作為零日漏洞利用
items.summary_zh: Armory Castle 利用 CVE-2026-102764 取得初始存取權限，部署了自訂工具，並刪除了日誌與痕跡。本篇《Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day》文章首次發表於 SecurityWeek。
